Full summary: Session close: pushed 5dee214 (plugin 1.24.1) to origin main; updated the plugin here in BOTH scopes (project was stale at 1.22.0 shadowing user 1.24.0 — both now 1.24.1, restart applies); persisted release state + verify-agent worktree-isolation lesson to session memory. No further repo file changes — post-record edits were to persistent memory outside the repo.
Findings: Field machine remains on broken plugin 1.24.0 until Dave updates it there — 1.24.1 is live in the marketplace, so `claude plugin marketplace update twining-marketplace` + `claude plugin update twining@twining-marketplace` per installed scope is the whole fix.; This repo's project-scope plugin pin was at 1.22.0 (pre-guard), silently shadowing user-scope 1.24.0 — which is why this machine's sessions never hit the every-session guard outage. When shipping plugin versions, verify BOTH scopes with `claude plugin list`.
